note: Images stay in datasets/ (gitignored) or a temp dir. Counts are the screens bench/safe-area.js read for results/safe-area.json; images_sha256 covers the sorted per-image sha256 list of the folder's PNGs. Committed results name a real screen only by a hash of its path inside its set (D34).

synthetic.plan: bench/safe-area.js (seed 73): ink 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24 or 32 px past the zone outline (D33; the home indicator 1 to 24 px, since 32 reaches the screen edge), or 2, 4 or 8 px short of it; even screen numbers dev, odd held out
synthetic.output: a temp dir (node bench/safe-area.js generates it; --keep <dir> keeps it)

rendered.output: a temp dir (--keep <dir> keeps it); results/safe-area-rendered.json

real.android: 1080x2400 lab screens from an unrecorded lab AVD, run with pixel-7 (D42); datasets/d2 (store and e2e screens of unknown devices) is not counted (D10)
